opus.approach: Soften the existing fan through parameters only, following Nick's 2026-10-08 method. Every variant retunes H33 (author_fan_front_lock_system_field.py) together with the matching H34 rear soften, in three steps of strength. Variant 1 rounds the lock section (p 1.8 to 2.2), switches to a convex leaf taper (ogive 1.3 1.5 to 1.6 .8) and gives blunter tips (tip-min .0035, tip-floor .6, from .0015 and .12). It also cuts curl and jitter, widens the lock and plate blends to .02 with the band raised, and melts the tuft and cup walls (tuft blur 1.5, tuft blend .008, rounded cup clip .016). On the rear it raises the skin blend to .010, the clump blend to .006, the tip-min to .0035, blur to 2 and dome blur to 10, aimed at the crown thorns and the dome ledge. Variant 2 is variant 1 with P2, P4 and P7 dropped per side and the remaining locks widened to 1.75 and thickened to 1.25, so the front reads as fewer, broader masses. Variant 3 is the strong bracket: blends of .03 and more, round tips, section p 2.4, ogive 2.0 .6, and H34 skin blend .014, blur 3, dome blur 14. The dry run estimates 77 minutes (56.6 scoring plus 20.4 candidate), which is over the 60-minute guide; I kept all three because each tests a separate step along the method. I followed the method rather than the spec's clump structure table, because the method forbids new lock geometry. No sweep was added because of the budget.

orders.changes: Added rebuild_arms_field_r30.py (copy of r28, new paw mode 'outline', lobes and digits untouched). The paw is the rounded intersection of two extruded outlines built from 2D signed-distance rasters (front table, side table, tip scallops as slots, outline and side rounding, table smoothing, smax roundRadius). A wristTable replaces the rod end and hands over to the paw field across a smooth weight, so no cuff ring forms. The four claws are probed from the built field and set just inside the tip along its outline normal. Candidate recipe r31-R07.json points B-23 at the new script with specs/arms-r30-v3.json. Measured on the built paw: paw over wrist 1.44, tip arch 0.83, claw tip span 0.014 in the front view, front outline error 0.002, side outline error 0.0055. Reading the render, the paw is a smooth rounded paw with four spread claws, though the scallops are only shallow lobes and the paw looks block-like in profile. Two earlier assemblies that also pushed the arm and shoulder out (assembled-2938 and assembled-2943) were abandoned: R05.3 reached 1.064, containment in R05 and R06 reached 0.0058 to 0.0157, and a new shoulder crease appeared. The kept spec v3 leaves the baseline shoulder, upper arm and swell unchanged, so the deltoid and the R07.6 arm-band push are not in this candidate. R07.6 stays at about 0.874. New seam flags remain at hip/front, hip/left and tailRoot/back, which is likely the wider paw in the back view and beside the hip, and still needs a look.
